scope.purpose: Reconcile product-page claims against official feedcharts and the current feedchart calculator before any manufacturer schedule enters runtime.

sources.finding: Official downloads page publishes dedicated Autoflower and LED Coco/Terra feedcharts.
Official schedule separates Cuttings/Seedlings, Vegetative weeks, Flowering weeks, hard/soft water, and final water-only week.
Current calculator requires nutrient line, tank size, water profile and Light/Standard/Heavy schedule profile before producing a personalised schedule.

scheduleFacts: Cuttings/seedlings use 5 ml/L in the explicit propagation context.
Early flowering root feed uses 0.2 ml/L for the first three flowering weeks.
reconciliations.residualIssue: The generic how-to line saying 5 ml/L to the tank is inconsistent with the explicit root-feed section, but it is lower-priority generic copy and must not drive a scheduled root-feed plan.

scheduleFacts: The official simplified feedchart uses 1 ml/L through vegetative and flowering schedule rows.
The current detailed Root Feed section and how-to text both state 1 ml/L.
reconciliations.residualIssue: The current page header still displays a 4 ml/L dilution rate. That remains an unresolved page-copy conflict, but does not override the explicit feedchart plus detailed root-feed instructions for schedule generation.

scheduleFacts: The official simplified feedchart uses 1 ml/L in the first PK week of the mid-flower window and 0.5 ml/L in the following weeks.
The current Product Info states 0.5 ml/L during flowering weeks 4-7 and allows up to 1.0 ml/L in the first week.
reconciliations.residualIssue: The current how-to image label says 4 ml/L while the adjacent text says 0.5 ml/L. Treat 4 ml/L as a conflicting copy/image label, never as the scheduled value.

scheduleFacts: Manufacturer schedule is week-specific and separates Terra Grow from Terra Bloom.
The official feedchart differentiates hard and soft water for Terra base dosing.
The current calculator also requires Light, Standard or Heavy feeding profile.
reconciliations.residualIssue: A single generic 2-3 ml/L or 1-4 ml/L value is insufficient for a manufacturer schedule.

availabilityConclusion.reason: The manufacturer publishes contextual schedules. Runtime still lacks phase-week, water profile and schedule profile, and the currently published dedicated LED feedchart has not yet been captured as machine-readable evidence.

required: capture exact current LED Coco/Terra feedchart values or deterministic calculator output for the chosen V1 profile
add the minimal missing context needed to choose a single schedule
promote only one concrete manufacturer context first
